name: Copenhagen Photo Festival 2025
description:
Køb online og spar 10% på alm. dagsbilletter! 

 English text below 

 Oplev fotografi i verdensklasse på årets fotofestival i København, der i år foregår i helt nye rammer i foyeren på Det Kgl. Teaters Gamle Scene centralt i byen. Her kan du opleve udstillinger med internationale navne, der udfolder samtidsfotografiet fra stjernefotograf til vækstlag. 

 I 2025 har festivalen for første gang indbudt den verdensberømte britiske Magnum-fotograf Martin Parr til at være årets absolutte highlight. 

 Sideløbende kan publikum opleve soloudstillinger med fire internationale fotografer, der er blevet udvalgt blandt 1000 ansøgere i et open call i efteråret 2024. Vinderne annonceres i marts.

 I festivalens centrum kan man desuden opleve talks, guidede ture, engagerende aktiviteter, et fotoprintmarked samt et to-dages fotobogmarked. 

 Festivalen skydes igang med en Grand Opening den 12. juni. 

 Udstillingerne i festivalens centrum kan opleves frem til og med den 18. juni. 

 NB! Udstillingerne i festivalens centrum er kun være åbne i perioden 12.-18. juni. Billetten giver dagsadgang til udstillingerne i festivalens centrum. Billetter til særarrangementer, fx. talks og guidede ture kræver særskilt billet. 

 Adgang til udstillinger hos vores festivalpartnere på museer mv., som kræver entré, er ikke indeholdt i denne billet. 

 ______________

 Buy online and get 10% discount on regular day tickets! 

 Experience world-class photography at Copenhagen Photo Festival 2025, which this year takes place in a completely new venue in the heart of the city. Here you can experience a series of exhibitions that unfold the depth of contemporary photography from star photographers to emerging talent. 

 In 2025, the festival has invited the world renowned Magnum photographer Martin Parr for the first time to be the absolute highlight of the year. 

 At the same time, the audience can experience solo exhibitions with four international photographers who have been selected from 1,000 applicants in an open call in the fall of 2024. The winners are announced in March.

 The festival center will also host talks, guided tours, engaging activities, a photo print market and a two-day photo book market. 

 The festival kicks off with a Grand Opening on June 12 at the festival center at the Royal Danish Theater. 

 The exhibitions in the festival center can be experienced until June 18. NB! The exhibitions in the festival center will only be open during the period June 12-18. The ticket gives day access to the exhibitions in the festival center. Tickets for special events, e.g. talks and guided tours require a separate ticket. Access to exhibitions at our festival partners at museums, etc., which require admission, is not included in this ticket. 

 Foto/photo: @ Martin Parr / Magnum Photos

name: Martin Parr · Opening Night Conversation · CPF+
description:
Joins us for the Opening Night Conversation with the world-renowned British Magnum photographer, Martin Parr. The conversation dives into Parr’s comprehensive work on leisure, tourism, and beach life as well as his lifelong dedication to photography. Not least how he keeps up the dedication and curiosity about his practice. 

 At the event Parr reflects on his approach to photography as a remarkable tool for unveiling paradoxes in our lifestyle and human condition, discusses his approach to documentary photography as well as unfolds perspectives on the development of photography over the course of his life from when he was 14 years old until today. 

 The impressive landmarks aside, Parr's insistent ongoing anthropological photographs reminds us of the ever-topical issue of being a human. A phenomenon that seems to be more relevant than ever to bring into the light.

 Parr has revolutionized documentary photography and is one of the most celebrated, award-winning, and published photographers in the world. During his more than 50-year-long career he has been president of Magnum Photos, published more than 120 photo books, and been exhibited worldwide. 

 In 2025 he is yet again topical. A new documentary feature ‘I am Martin Parr’ about his impressive work and career is out in cinemas across the world this spring, and in September Penguin Books releases a new autobiography, ‘Utterly lazy and inattentive’ , about his long and influential career.

 NB Only a very limited number of tickets are available. If the event is sold out we recommend to sign up on the waiting list, so we can contact you, if additional tickets are released. The ticket also gives access to the exhibitions at the festival center at Gamle Scene 12 June.
